title: Finite constant coefficient action cup in ordinary etale cohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $N\in\mathbf N$, and work on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $R=\mathbf Z/N\mathbf Z$, with the common universe lift, use the constant-module and ordinary class comparison of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class], and let $U$ be the exact functor forgetting sheaves of $R$-modules to abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], as in [def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison]. Let $A$ be the constant free rank-one $R$-module sheaf [def-kun-constant-sheaf], let $a:R_X\to U(A)$ be the canonical constant-section map obtained by sheafifying the constant-presheaf unit, and put $z:\mathbf Z_X\to U(A)$ equal to reduction followed by $a$. For every $R$-module sheaf $M$, define $c_M^i:\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(A,M)\to H^i(X,U(M))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] by applying the exact functor $U$ to an extension and Yoneda-precomposing with $z$. For an abelian sheaf $F$, define the predicate $\operatorname{IsFiniteEtaleCup}(X,N,F,\beta)$ on families $\beta^{i,j}:H^i(X,R_X)\times H^j(X,F)\to H^{i+j}(X,F)$ by the following explicit representative condition: for every $R$-module sheaf $M$, every isomorphism $e:U(M)\simeq F$, every $i,j\geq0$, every $x_0\in H^i(X,R_X)$, and extensions $x\in\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(A,A)$ and $y\in\operatorname{Ext}^j_R(A,M)$ with $H^i(a)x_0=c_A^i(x)$, require $\beta^{i,j}(x_0,H^j(e)c_M^j(y))=H^{i+j}(e)c_M^{i+j}(x\mathbin{\circ_Y}y)$, where $x\mathbin{\circ_Y}y$ is the Yoneda composite in the order $A\xrightarrow{x}A[i]\xrightarrow{y[i]}M[i+j]$ in the derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Milne §22, Cup-products, p.135; Stacks Tag 0FPJ, section-cup-product: specialization to a constant finite coefficient ring and its rank-one unit; Ext/Yoneda model of the same unit action. Milne §14, pp.102–103: module-sheaf cohomology comparison and Yoneda/iterated-boundary pairing.
